```{r}
# DEFINE SELECTED VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

cat("\n📝 DEFINING SELECTED VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Define the variables you want to keep
selected_variables <- c(
  # Parcel identification (we'll add the processed IDs)
  "Parc.Detaillee",           # Original parcel name
  "Annee",                    # Year
  
  # Your selected soil measurement variables
  "Date_prelevement", 
  "pH", 
  "C.N", 
  "CE_mmho_cm", 
  "Ca_ech_me_100g", 
  "Mg_ech_me_100g", 
  "Na_ech_me_100g", 
  "K_ech_me_100g", 
  "P2O5_assimilable_mg_kg", 
  "Argiles", 
  "Limons_fins", 
  "Limons_grossiers", 
  "Sables_fins", 
  "Sables_grossiers", 
  "Carbone_organique_pour_mille", 
  "Azote_total_pour_mille", 
  "Limons", 
  "Sables", 
  "Matiere_organique.", 
  "S.Ca.Mg.K.Na..me.100g", 
  "CaO_g.100g", 
  "Mg.Ca", 
  "Mg.K", 
  "Indice_de_batance", 
  "Texture"
)

# Check which variables exist in the soil data
available_vars <- selected_variables[selected_variables %in% names(soil_data_manual)]
missing_vars <- selected_variables[!selected_variables %in% names(soil_data_manual)]

cat("✅ Available variables:", length(available_vars), "\n")
cat("⚠️  Missing variables:", length(missing_vars), "\n")

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("\nMissing variables:\n")
  for (var in missing_vars) {
    cat("• ", var, "\n")
  }
  
  # Try to find similar variable names
  cat("\n🔍 Looking for similar variable names in dataset:\n")
  all_vars <- names(soil_data_manual)
  for (missing_var in missing_vars) {
    # Simple similarity check
    similar_vars <- c()
    for (existing_var in all_vars) {
      # Check if any part of the missing variable name appears in existing variable
      missing_parts <- unlist(strsplit(missing_var, "[._]"))
      for (part in missing_parts) {
        if (nchar(part) > 2 && grepl(part, existing_var, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          similar_vars <- c(similar_vars, existing_var)
          break
        }
      }
    }
    if (length(similar_vars) > 0) {
      cat("  '", missing_var, "' might be: ", paste(unique(similar_vars), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE CLEAN SOIL DATASET
# ============================================================================

cat("\n🔧 CREATING CLEAN SOIL DATASET:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Start with the manually corrected soil data
clean_soil_data <- soil_data_manual

# Add the processed parcel ID columns
clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Original <- clean_soil_data$Parc.Detaillee_UPPER
clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Manual_Corrected <- clean_soil_data$Parc_Manual_Corrected
clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Cleaned_Final <- clean_soil_data$Parc_Manual_CLEANED

# Select only the available variables plus our parcel ID columns
final_variables <- c(
  "Parcel_ID_Original",           # Original parcel name (uppercase)
  "Parcel_ID_Manual_Corrected",   # After manual corrections
  "Parcel_ID_Cleaned_Final",      # Final cleaned version for matching
  available_vars                  # Your selected variables that exist
)

# Create the final clean dataset
clean_soil_data <- clean_soil_data[, final_variables]

# Add some metadata columns
clean_soil_data$Manual_Correction_Applied <- clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Original != clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Manual_Corrected
clean_soil_data$Data_Processing_Date <- Sys.Date()

# ============================================================================
# DATA QUALITY SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 DATA QUALITY SUMMARY:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

cat("Total records in clean dataset:", nrow(clean_soil_data), "\n")
cat("Total variables in clean dataset:", ncol(clean_soil_data), "\n")

# Count records with manual corrections
manual_corrections <- sum(clean_soil_data$Manual_Correction_Applied, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Records with manual parcel ID corrections:", manual_corrections, "\n")

# Show unique parcels
unique_original <- length(unique(clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Original))
unique_final <- length(unique(clean_soil_data$Parcel_ID_Cleaned_Final))
cat("Unique parcels (original names):", unique_original, "\n")
cat("Unique parcels (final cleaned):", unique_final, "\n")

# Year range
if ("Annee" %in% names(clean_soil_data)) {
  years <- clean_soil_data$Annee[!is.na(clean_soil_data$Annee)]
  if (length(years) > 0) {
    cat("Year range:", min(years), "to", max(years), "\n")
    cat("Years with data:", paste(sort(unique(years)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# Missing data summary for selected variables
cat("\n📋 MISSING DATA SUMMARY FOR SELECTED VARIABLES:\n")
measurement_vars <- available_vars[!available_vars %in% c("Parc.Detaillee", "Annee", "Date_prelevement")]

for (var in measurement_vars) {
  missing_count <- sum(is.na(clean_soil_data[[var]]))
  missing_pct <- round((missing_count / nrow(clean_soil_data)) * 100, 1)
  cat(sprintf("%-30s: %4d missing (%5.1f%%)\n", substr(var, 1, 30), missing_count, missing_pct))
}

# ============================================================================
# EXPORT CLEAN DATASET
# ============================================================================

cat("\n💾 EXPORTING CLEAN DATASET:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Create output folder
output_folder <- "clean_soil_dataset"
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder)
  cat("✅ Created output folder:", output_folder, "\n")
}

# Export main clean dataset
output_filename <- file.path(output_folder, "clean_soil_data_with_matched_parcels.csv")
write.csv(clean_soil_data, output_filename, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

cat("✅ Exported clean soil dataset to:", output_filename, "\n")

# Create a data dictionary
data_dictionary <- data.frame(
  Variable_Name = names(clean_soil_data),
  Variable_Type = sapply(clean_soil_data, class),
  Description = c(
    "Original parcel name (uppercase)",
    "Parcel name after manual corrections",  
    "Final cleaned parcel name for GIS matching",
    "Original parcel name (mixed case)",
    "Year of sampling",
    if ("Date_prelevement" %in% available_vars) "Sampling date" else NULL,
    if ("pH" %in% available_vars) "Soil pH" else NULL,
    if ("C.N" %in% available_vars) "Carbon to Nitrogen ratio" else NULL,
    if ("CE_mmho_cm" %in% available_vars) "Electrical conductivity (mmho/cm)" else NULL,
    if ("Ca_ech_me_100g" %in% available_vars) "Exchangeable Calcium (me/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("Mg_ech_me_100g" %in% available_vars) "Exchangeable Magnesium (me/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("Na_ech_me_100g" %in% available_vars) "Exchangeable Sodium (me/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("K_ech_me_100g" %in% available_vars) "Exchangeable Potassium (me/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("P2O5_assimilable_mg_kg" %in% available_vars) "Assimilable P2O5 (mg/kg)" else NULL,
    if ("Argiles" %in% available_vars) "Clay content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Limons_fins" %in% available_vars) "Fine silt content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Limons_grossiers" %in% available_vars) "Coarse silt content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Sables_fins" %in% available_vars) "Fine sand content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Sables_grossiers" %in% available_vars) "Coarse sand content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Carbone_organique_pour_mille" %in% available_vars) "Organic carbon (‰)" else NULL,
    if ("Azote_total_pour_mille" %in% available_vars) "Total nitrogen (‰)" else NULL,
    if ("Limons" %in% available_vars) "Total silt content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Sables" %in% available_vars) "Total sand content (%)" else NULL,
    if ("Matiere_organique." %in% available_vars) "Organic matter (%)" else NULL,
    if ("S.Ca.Mg.K.Na..me.100g" %in% available_vars) "Sum of exchangeable cations (me/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("CaO_g.100g" %in% available_vars) "Calcium oxide (g/100g)" else NULL,
    if ("Mg.Ca" %in% available_vars) "Mg/Ca ratio" else NULL,
    if ("Mg.K" %in% available_vars) "Mg/K ratio" else NULL,
    if ("Indice_de_batance" %in% available_vars) "Balance index" else NULL,
    if ("Texture" %in% available_vars) "Soil texture class" else NULL,
    "Whether manual parcel name correction was applied",
    "Date when this dataset was processed"
  ),
  Non_Missing_Count = sapply(clean_soil_data, function(x) sum(!is.na(x))),
  Missing_Count = sapply(clean_soil_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove NULL entries from Description
data_dictionary$Description <- ifelse(is.null(data_dictionary$Description), "", data_dictionary$Description)

dict_filename <- file.path(output_folder, "data_dictionary.csv")
write.csv(data_dictionary, dict_filename, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

cat("✅ Exported data dictionary to:", dict_filename, "\n")

# Create a summary report
summary_report <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total records",
    "Total variables", 
    "Variables requested",
    "Variables found", 
    "Variables missing",
    "Records with manual corrections",
    "Unique parcels (original)",
    "Unique parcels (final cleaned)",
    "Year range",
    "Processing date"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(clean_soil_data),
    ncol(clean_soil_data),
    length(selected_variables),
    length(available_vars),
    length(missing_vars),
    manual_corrections,
    unique_original,
    unique_final,
    if ("Annee" %in% names(clean_soil_data) && length(years) > 0) paste(min(years), "to", max(years)) else "Not available",
    as.character(Sys.Date())
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

summary_filename <- file.path(output_folder, "dataset_summary.csv")
write.csv(summary_report, summary_filename, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

cat("✅ Exported dataset summary to:", summary_filename, "\n")
```

## III.5. Shapefile Data Export

This section adds the final cleaned parcel identifier to the shapefile as the second column and exports it in ESRI Shapefile format with all component files, preserving the UTM coordinate system for seamless integration with the soil dataset.

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# EXPORT SHAPEFILE WITH FINAL CLEANED PARCEL ID
# ============================================================================
# This script exports your shapefile with only the final cleaned parcel ID 
# added as the second column

cat("=== EXPORTING SHAPEFILE WITH FINAL CLEANED PARCEL ID ===\n")

# Load required libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# VERIFY REQUIRED DATA IS AVAILABLE
# ============================================================================

cat("📋 VERIFYING REQUIRED SPATIAL DATA:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Check if we have the processed shapefile from previous analysis
if (!exists("parcelles_filtered") && !exists("parcelles")) {
  cat("⚠️  Shapefile data not found in environment.\n")
  cat("🔄 Attempting to load shapefile...\n")
  
  # Try to load the shapefile (you may need to adjust the path)
  shp_files <- list.files(pattern = "*.shp$", recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(shp_files) > 0) {
    cat("Found shapefile(s):\n")
    for (i in 1:length(shp_files)) {
      cat(i, ". ", shp_files[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\n⚠️  Please ensure your shapefile is loaded as 'parcelles' or 'parcelles_filtered'\n")
    cat("Example: parcelles <- st_read('your_shapefile.shp')\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("❌ No shapefile found in current directory\n")
    cat("Please load your shapefile first:\n")
    cat("parcelles <- st_read('path/to/your/shapefile.shp')\n\n")
  }
  stop("Shapefile data required. Please load your shapefile first.")
}

# Use the available shapefile data
if (exists("parcelles_filtered")) {
  parcelles <- parcelles_filtered
  cat("✅ Using 'parcelles_filtered' from previous analysis\n")
} else if (exists("parcelles")) {
  cat("✅ Using 'parcelles' shapefile\n")
} else {
  stop("No shapefile data available")
}

# Verify it's a spatial object
if (!inherits(parcelles, "sf")) {
  stop("❌ Parcelles object is not a valid sf spatial object")
}

cat("Shapefile loaded successfully:\n")
cat("• Features (polygons):", nrow(parcelles), "\n")
cat("• Columns:", ncol(parcelles), "\n")
cat("• CRS:", st_crs(parcelles)$input, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# RECREATE CLEANING FUNCTION IF NEEDED
# ============================================================================

if (!exists("clean_parcel_name")) {
  clean_parcel_name <- function(name) {
    if (is.na(name) || name == "") return("")
    cleaned <- toupper(trimws(name))
    cleaned <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", cleaned)
    cleaned <- gsub("PARCELLE", "PARC", cleaned)
    cleaned <- gsub("PARCEL", "PARC", cleaned)
    cleaned <- gsub("BLOC", "BL", cleaned)
    cleaned <- gsub("SECTEUR", "SECT", cleaned)
    return(cleaned)
  }
  cat("✅ Recreated parcel name cleaning function\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# PROCESS SHAPEFILE WITH FINAL CLEANED ID
# ============================================================================

cat("\n🔧 PROCESSING SHAPEFILE WITH FINAL CLEANED ID:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Display current column names
cat("Current shapefile columns:\n")
shp_cols <- names(st_drop_geometry(parcelles))
for (i in 1:length(shp_cols)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %-20s\n", i, shp_cols[i]))
}

# Identify the field column (parcel identifier)
field_column <- NULL
possible_field_cols <- c("field", "Field", "FIELD", "parcel", "Parcel", "PARCEL", 
                        "id", "ID", "Id", "nom", "NOM", "name", "NAME")

for (col in possible_field_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(parcelles)) {
    field_column <- col
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(field_column)) {
  cat("\n❌ Could not automatically identify parcel ID column.\n")
  cat("Available columns:\n")
  print(names(st_drop_geometry(parcelles)))
  cat("\nPlease specify the correct column name manually:\n")
  cat("Example: field_column <- 'your_parcel_id_column_name'\n")
  stop("Parcel ID column identification required")
}

cat("\n✅ Using parcel ID column:", field_column, "\n")

# Create final cleaned parcel ID
cat("\n🔧 Creating final cleaned parcel ID...\n")
final_cleaned_id <- sapply(toupper(parcelles[[field_column]]), clean_parcel_name)

# Create new shapefile with final cleaned ID in second position
cat("📝 Adding final cleaned ID as second column...\n")

# Get all columns except geometry
data_cols <- st_drop_geometry(parcelles)

# Create new data frame with final cleaned ID as second column
new_data <- data.frame(
  data_cols[1],  # First original column
  Final_Cleaned_ID = final_cleaned_id,  # Our new column in second position
  data_cols[2:ncol(data_cols)]  # Rest of original columns
)

# Create new sf object with the reordered columns
final_shapefile <- st_sf(new_data, geometry = st_geometry(parcelles))

# Verify the column order
cat("\n✅ Final shapefile columns:\n")
final_cols <- names(st_drop_geometry(final_shapefile))
for (i in 1:length(final_cols)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %-20s", i, final_cols[i]))
  if (i == 2) cat(" ← Final cleaned ID")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("\n📊 SUMMARY:\n")
cat("• Total parcels:", nrow(final_shapefile), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(final_shapefile), "\n")
cat("• Final cleaned ID added as column 2\n")

# ============================================================================
# EXPORT FINAL SHAPEFILE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n💾 EXPORTING FINAL SHAPEFILE:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Create output folder
output_folder <- "clean_soil_dataset"
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder)
}

# Export the final shapefile
shapefile_path <- file.path(output_folder, "parcels_with_final_id")

# Remove existing files if they exist
existing_files <- list.files(output_folder, pattern = "parcels_with_final_id.*", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(existing_files) > 0) {
  file.remove(existing_files)
}

# Write shapefile
st_write(final_shapefile, paste0(shapefile_path, ".shp"), 
         driver = "ESRI Shapefile", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

cat("✅ Exported final shapefile to:", paste0(shapefile_path, ".shp"), "\n")

# Export attribute table for reference
attr_filename <- file.path(output_folder, "final_shapefile_attributes.csv")
write.csv(st_drop_geometry(final_shapefile), attr_filename, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
